lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: All right, let's get started.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: To shine BOOM onto the clouds, we'll need some pretty powerful equipment.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Something that can beam light all the way up into the sky.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Is there anything on this ship that could shoot light that far?
What if we use a searchlight?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hmm...
A searchlight can shoot out a really strong beam, can't it?
We could use it to build a projector that can cast images into the sky.
... Would that not work?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: That's a crazy idea.
Yeah... I thought so.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: ... Crazy enough that it might just work.
Huh?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Modifying a searchlight into a projector? No way I'm passing up something that fun, hehe!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It's settled. Let's do it.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Let's see... What do we need for a projector?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: First, we'll start by making the lens.
Our endeavor to project BOOM onto the clouds has begun.
Codename: Operation BOOM Eternal is officially underway.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: This looks usable as a lens.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: The size isn't quite right, but it should work fine with some minor tweaks.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Good thing I brought everything I might need for a job like this.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Mr. Commander, could you go to my room and bring me my yellow bag?
The entire thing?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Yes please!
Elegg runs around excitedly, completely absorbed in her task.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: We'll need a motor with the right output and size to spin the color wheel...
How about this one?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Where'd you get something like that?
I asked Centi for help, and she pulled something out of a home appliance.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I knew I could count on you, Mr. Commander.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Let's see... If we attach this part right here...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehe. It's spinning! It's actually spinning!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Uh... actually, maybe a bit too fast.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: The motor's coming this way.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Gaaah!
I act as Elegg's assistant for what feels like an extraordinarily long time.
Why don't we take a break?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Are you mad?!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: If we want this finished by tonight, there's no time to rest.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Come on! Let's get moving.
But I'm exhausted...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I promise I'll let you rest plenty once we're done.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: But right now, we've gotta keep our noses to the grindstone.
*Sigh*...
Before we know it, the sun has set and night has fallen.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Mr. Commander, can you plug the cable in right there?
The red one or the blue one?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: The red one.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: If everything's working correctly, it should start blinking once it's plugged in.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Once that's done and I link up the connector, the searchlight, which I've modified into a projector, should turn on.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It might be a little dangerous when the searchlight turns on, so once the connection's complete, don't stand too close.
It's not going to explode or anything, is it?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: ... Probably.
I carefully follow the instructions that Elegg gave me.
It's plugged in.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Is the light blinking?
Yeah. It's blinking.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehehe. Then everything's ready.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Whew...
Nervous?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: A little, yeah.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: What if I plug in the connector and nothing happens?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: What if I mess up this once-in-a-lifetime chance?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't a little worried.
Don't be.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Yeah?
Knowing you, this all will work no problem.
And even if it doesn't, we can try again.
You can have as many cracks at it as you need.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: ... Yeah, you're right.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Even if it fails, I can always try again.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Guess I was overthinking things. Hehe.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: All right, stand back. I'm going to count to three and plug it in.
Okay.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Here we go.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: One.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Two.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Three!
*Click*
*Fwoosh*
As Elegg joins the connector, the searchlight powers on,
BOOM.
and BOOM fills the entire night sky.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Look, Mr. Commander! It's BOOM! It's really there!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It's a little blurry, but that's BOOM! No doubt about it!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It worked!

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Wow, would you look at that. It actually worked.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: I have to admit, it's actually kind of pretty.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: Is that what was showing up on my thermometer?

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Game looks cool.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Might play sometime. Once.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: Maybe we should ask Elegg to move it somewhere less disruptive next time.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Why can't we do stuff like this back on the Ark?

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: If we had advertisements like this back there, sales would skyrocket.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Dangerous.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Yeah... I guess you've got a point.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: If we weren't careful, it'd be another Dome of Eternity incident all over again.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: People would realize the sky they thought was real wasn't, and they'd freak out.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Real. Fake. Huge difference.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Fine, fine. Guess I have to let that dream die.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: I'll have to settle for enjoying it in the here and now.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: A video game being projected across the night sky...

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Quite a surreal sight.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: It may not be the moon or the stars, but I suppose this isn't such a bad view.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: I would have never thought this kind of thing was possible.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: It feels like I'm dreaming.
I can't believe it actually worked.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Yes! It actually worked!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: We really installed BOOM into the sky.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: When you first brought up the idea of projecting images onto clouds, I was skeptical.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Then I wasn't sure

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: if we'd be able to successfully modify the searchlight.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: But the proof is in the pudding, and it's right there above our heads.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: That's our creation up there.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It feels like I've fulfilled a lifelong dream...
Elegg gazes up at the sky with a look of wonderment.
So? Think you're out of your slump now?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: You bet.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: If something this spectacular couldn't snap me out of it, I don't know what could.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I think... I've gone as far as I can go.
Really?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehehe. No way!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I won't be satisfied until I've spread BOOM across the entire world.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Today was a big step towards achieving that dream,

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: but there's still a long road ahead.
Then I'm rooting for you.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Would you like to try playing it?
I think I would.
Nah, I'm happy with just watching it.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehe, I knew you'd say that.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: There's no way you could just sit back after seeing something this awesome.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: All right then, as for the controller... oh, right. It's on my swimsuit.
In that case, I think I'll pass...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Aw man... I really wanted to try it. Then again...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Okay. Sitting back and taking in something this grand is a nice feeling too.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: That's what art is all about, isn't it?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: But the next time we get a chance like this, we should try playing the game.
Sure thing. I'm looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehe. Me too.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Sitting back and soaking in this amazing view

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: is plenty satisfying in its own right.
As Elegg and I chit chat about this and that,
we sit back and continue to watch BOOM projected onto the clouds in the night sky.
A little while later...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It's fading...
As the clouds part and the moon and stars begin to peek through,
BOOM begins to slowly fade.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Too bad. I wish I could have watched it a while longer.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: But now that I know

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: what it feels like to launch BOOM into the sky,

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I'm even more certain about what I want to do next.
What's that?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Someday,

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Ms. Trony and I will bring the sky back to the people.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Not the fake sky you see on the Dome of Eternity, but the real thing.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: And on that day, when we no longer need the Dome of Eternity...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I'll light it up with BOOM.
Pretty BOOMtastic.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehe, you think so too?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: All this has made me more motivated than ever to achieve my goal.
I guess we'll have to reclaim the surface soon then.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: That's the first hurdle that we have to overcome.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: You'll help me to get there, won't you?
You know I will.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehe. Thanks.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: ... Well, I think I've gotten over my slump, and I feel recharged.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Should we get back to work?
You mean there's more work to do?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Like I said, I'm going to spread BOOM all over the world.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: My work will never be done, not until the entire world is filled with BOOM.
I should have known this is how it would end...

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: With how big the sky is, we've got our work cut out for us!
